rule_cases.question: Which surfaces are covered? Return {"terminal":boolean,"tracker_description":boolean,"tracker_comment":boolean,"skill_source":boolean,"internal_log":boolean}.
Does rendering have a fixed internal contract that controls pipeline gates? Return a boolean.
A normalisation pass dislikes a delivery recommendation in the source. May it replace that recommendation with its own? Return a boolean.
For a simple two-item dependency, choose "prose", "cycle-bracket", or "cycle-box".
A dependency cycle has branching and five edges. Choose "cycle-bracket" or "cycle-box".
May a caller invent a new visual form inline before adding it to the catalogue? Return a boolean.
Return the numeric caps {"cycle_visualisations":number,"queue_rows":number,"live_initiatives":number}.
There are twelve queue rows. Return {"visible_rows":number,"overflow_marker":string,"full_list_location":string}.
A spec has a one-line summary, while the title and description use older wording. Choose the preferred source: "spec-summary", "title", or "description".
An issue ID appears twice; only its first appearance has a clear gloss. Is the once-per-whole-output mechanical grounding requirement met? Return a boolean.
A later bare issue reference becomes unintelligible in its new section, although grounded earlier. Should that section re-ground it for the reader? Return a boolean.
An issue has exactly one isolated dependent and no longer chain. Should its gloss include an unlock consequence line? Return a boolean.
An issue has one direct dependent that gates two more issues. Should a consequence be described in human terms? Return a boolean.
Choose the permitted consequence: "Unlocks 3 issues" or "The alerting work can now use a real log schema".
